title: agrostis decumbens var. coarctata
intro: Agrostis decumbens var. coarctata, commonly known as bent grass or creeping bent, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is a perennial, rhizomatous grass that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis decumbens var. coarctata include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
